author: MiYu
scope: Same published Warcraft scene; paused native editor. Delivery includes readiness and webview event scheduling. Reply includes serialization, IPC and socket/client handling. Wall-clock delivery intervals are approximate; operation and queue durations use the frontend monotonic clock.

profile.note: WebView timing plus instrumented native editor-host/RHI call tree, memory provenance, and render-bound resources. GPU bytes are estimates; driver timing and process-wide heap sampling are not claimed.

memory.name: Frame packet / render objects
memory.source: Rust shallow size for compiled render objects

memory.name: Frame packet / UI primitives
memory.source: Rust shallow size for compiled UI primitives

memory.name: Frame packet / UI batches
memory.source: Rust shallow size for compiled UI batches

memory.name: Frame packet / controls
memory.source: Rust shallow size for compiled UI controls

memory.name: GPU offscreen color
memory.source: viewport width x height x 4 RGBA8 bytes

memory.name: GPU offscreen depth
memory.source: viewport width x height x 4 depth/stencil bytes x MSAA samples; physical format is backend-dependent

memory.name: GPU HDR and multisampled color
memory.source: resolved RGBA16F plus MSAA RGBA16F and surface RGBA8 attachments; excludes driver allocation padding

memory.name: GPU texture residency
memory.source: render-bound texture dimensions x 4 RGBA8 bytes; mipmaps excluded

memory.name: GPU live scene views
memory.source: resolved RGBA8 and RGBA16F, depth/stencil and MSAA color attachments; excludes driver padding
